name: Speed Quiz
description: Trivia questions, faster correct answers earn more points. Swap in your own questions.

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Sydney and Melbourne both wanted the title, so Canberra was purpose-built between them in 1913.
questions.discussionPrompt: What made Sydney the tempting answer? What does "biggest city" have to do with "capital"?

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury orbits closest, about 58 million km out. Venus is hotter, but second in line.
questions.discussionPrompt: Why might someone answer Venus? What is the difference between closest and hottest?

questions.question: How many sides does a hexagon have?
questions.explanation: Hex means six, the same root as in hexadecimal. A honeycomb cell is a hexagon.
questions.discussionPrompt: Name another word that hides a number in it. How did you know?

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific covers about a third of the planet, bigger than all the land put together.
questions.discussionPrompt: What did the wrong answers have in common? Where on a map do people guess big?

questions.question: In what year did World War II end?
questions.explanation: Germany surrendered in May 1945 and Japan in August, so 1945 ends the war on both fronts.
questions.discussionPrompt: What other dates were tempting, and what happened in those years?
